find:
if (index === undefined) refused.push({ action, control, reason: 'unknown-control' });
    else pending.set(action, { control, index });
why: A binding may only target a control the profile names; a stale or foreign control id must be refused as unknown, not turned into a raw button index the profile never vouched for.
killedBy: resolveEffectiveProfile (issue #754) refuses a control the profile does not name, and the action keeps its own button
